title: Quik Unbind
description: Adds a simple "×" button to the controls menu to instantly unbind keys. No more clicking and pressing Escape—just one click to clear any keybinding.
body:
# ❌ Quick Unbind
Quick Unbind is a lightweight, client-side utility mod that adds a dedicated "Unbind" button to the Minecraft controls menu.

Tired of having to click a keybind, press Escape, or manually hunt through config files just to clear a shortcut? This mod simplifies the process by adding a small, intuitive "×" button next to every keybinding in your options menu.

## ✨ Features
**One-Click Unbind:** Clear any keybinding instantly with a single click on the red "×".

**Seamless Integration:** The button fits perfectly into the vanilla Minecraft UI, located right next to the "Reset" button.

**Vanilla Friendly:** Uses standard Minecraft logic to ensure your options are saved correctly and instantly updated.

**Lightweight:** Minimal impact on performance, written with clean Mixins for maximum compatibility.

## 🛠 How to use
Go to Options > Controls > Key Binds.

Look for the red "×" button next to the Reset button of any entry.

Click it to set the keybind to NONE (Unknown).
